Day 1
Culture
Day 1
Antananarivo

Gateway to Madagascar

Welcome to Madagascar. Upon arrival in Antananarivo — the highland capital known as Tana — you will be met at the airport and transferred to your hotel conveniently located nearby. With modern amenities, warm hospitality and an on-site restaurant, it provides the perfect place to relax and unwind after your international journey. If time allows before sunset, the Rova palace complex and the hilltop views over the terracotta city are well worth a short visit.

Airport welcome & transferHighland capital city viewsOptional Rova palace visitOn-site restaurant & bar
Most international flights arrive into Antananarivo. Your hotel is a short transfer from the airport — typically 20–30 minutes depending on traffic.
Days 2–5
Adventure
Days 2–5
Morondava

The Avenue of the Baobabs

After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Morondava on Madagascar's picturesque west coast. On arrival you will be met and transferred to your beachfront hotel, where you can settle in and enjoy the relaxed coastal atmosphere. Morondava is the gateway to some of Madagascar's most iconic landscapes — the Avenue of the Baobabs, the Kirindy Forest Reserve and the traditional fishing villages that line the coastline. These extraordinary trees, some over 800 years old, are best experienced at sunrise or sunset when the light turns golden and the silhouettes are at their most dramatic.

Avenue of the Baobabs at sunrise & sunsetKirindy Forest Reserve — fossas & lemursBaobab in Love — the entwined twin baobabsTraditional fishing village visitsBeachfront hotel on the west coast
The flight from Antananarivo to Morondava takes approximately 1.5 hours. The Avenue of the Baobabs is 20 minutes from town — an early start is strongly recommended for the sunrise visit.
Day 5
Departure
Day 5
Return to Antananarivo

Back to the Highlands

After breakfast, transfer to Morondava Airport for your return flight to Antananarivo. Upon arrival you will be transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay. Enjoy a relaxed evening and take time to unwind — perhaps exploring the lively Analakely market or dining at one of Tana's excellent highland restaurants — before your onward journey to northern Madagascar the following morning.

Return flight to AntananarivoOvernight hotel near the airportOptional Analakely market visitHighland cuisine & restaurants
Tana can be surprisingly busy with traffic. Allow extra time for all transfers and confirm your morning flight time the evening before.
Days 6–11
Islands
Days 6–11
Nosy Be

Island Life

After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Nosy Be — Madagascar's premier island destination. On arrival, transfer to your hotel set along Nosy Be's beautiful coastline. Combining tropical elegance with modern comfort, the hotel offers panoramic ocean views, a tranquil spa and easy access to a variety of marine and island excursions. Whether you prefer to relax by the beach or explore the surrounding islands and coral reefs, Nosy Be offers the perfect balance of adventure and relaxation. Six nights gives you plenty of time to take in the island at your own pace.

Beachfront hotel with ocean viewsIsland exploration at your own paceDay trips to surrounding islandsOptional whale shark excursion (seasonal)Snorkelling, diving & water sports
Flights from Antananarivo to Nosy Be take approximately 1.5 hours. Multiple optional excursions are available from Nosy Be — your TMC guide will help you plan each day.
Days 11–12
Marine
Days 11–12
Nosy Iranja

Turtle Island

After breakfast, depart for Nosy Iranja — often referred to as Turtle Island. This breathtaking tropical paradise is famous for its pristine white sandbar connecting two islands at low tide, surrounded by crystal-clear turquoise water and vibrant marine life. Spend your time swimming, snorkelling in the lagoon or simply relaxing in an untouched island setting. In the evening, settle into your charming rustic beach villa. During nesting season you may have the extraordinary opportunity to witness sea turtles coming ashore under the stars.

Iconic white sandbar at low tideCrystal-clear snorkelling lagoonOvernight in rustic beach villaSea turtle nesting (seasonal)Freshly prepared seafood lunch on the beach
Nosy Iranja is reached by speedboat from Nosy Be — approximately 1.5 hours depending on sea conditions. Overnight stays are arranged in advance.
Days 12–14
Wildlife
Days 12–14
Nosy Komba

Eco-Luxury on the Lemur Island

In the morning, transfer from Nosy Iranja to the lush volcanic island of Nosy Komba. Your accommodation offers an eco-luxury experience surrounded by tropical forest and secluded beaches. Beautifully designed bungalows overlook the sea, while the lodge's restaurant serves fresh cuisine inspired by local Malagasy flavours. During your stay, enjoy guided nature walks where black lemurs approach freely, snorkelling from the island's shore, kayaking in calm waters and visits to the beachfront village where you can experience authentic Malagasy culture and warm island hospitality.

Semi-wild black lemur encountersEco-luxury bungalow accommodationGuided forest & village walksKayaking & snorkelling from shoreAuthentic Malagasy cuisine
Nosy Komba is a 20-minute boat transfer from Nosy Iranja. No vehicles on the island — all movement is on foot or by water.
Day 14
Departure
Day 14
Departure

Farewell to Madagascar

After a final breakfast with views of the ocean, transfer from Nosy Komba to Nosy Be Airport for your departing flight. As you cross the turquoise channel for the last time, reflect on two weeks that have taken you from the highland capital to the world's most iconic avenue of trees, and from a premier island base to some of the most remote and beautiful anchorages in the Indian Ocean. Madagascar has a way of staying with you long after you leave.

Final breakfast on Nosy KombaScenic boat transfer to Nosy BeAirport transfer & departure
Allow sufficient time for the boat transfer and check-in. Early departures from Nosy Be can be arranged with advance notice.

Optional Activities

Experience More

Optional excursions and activities are available to enhance this journey.

Adventure
Avenue of the Baobabs

Madagascar’s most iconic landscape at sunrise or sunset — centuries-old baobabs lining a dusty red road.

Wildlife
Kirindy Forest Reserve

Dry deciduous forest home to the elusive fossa, lemurs, endemic birds and remarkable nocturnal wildlife.

Adventure
Lovers’ Baobab & Sacred Tree

Discover the fascinating legends and cultural significance surrounding these ancient and majestic entwined baobab trees near Morondava.

Marine
Tanikely Marine Reserve

World-class snorkelling in crystal-clear waters with vibrant coral reefs and tropical fish.

Marine
Whale Shark Excursion

Swim alongside gentle whale sharks in their natural habitat off Nosy Be.

Seasonal: Oct – Dec
Marine
Sakatia Turtle Excursion

Snorkel with sea turtles in the protected waters surrounding Nosy Sakatia.

Adventure
Horse Riding Adventure

Experience scenic beach and forest trails accompanied by professional guides.

Adventure
Quad Biking Excursion

Explore Nosy Be’s countryside and coastal landscapes on an exciting quad bike adventure.

This journey is a starting point

The Madagascar Discovery Tour covers the broadest possible sweep of the island in two weeks. It can be extended, reordered or combined with a Luna Moon sailing expedition for a truly extraordinary journey.

Tell us about your trip and we'll come back within 24 hours with ideas and a first sketch of your journey.
